name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/api/health.ts

The `/health` endpoint incorrectly reports `"version": "dev"` in production because it falls back to the default value when `process.env.npm_package_version` is not set. The service is started directly via `node dist/index.js` instead of through npm, so the environment variable is missing. The fix should ensure the correct version (`3.2.1`) is read from `package.json` or another reliable source.

input.title: Fix health endpoint to report correct version in production
input.body:
File: src/api/health.ts

The health endpoint currently uses `process.env.npm_package_version` to determine the version, falling back to "dev" if it is not set. However, the service is started with `node dist/index.js` in production, which does not set this environment variable. This causes the endpoint to always report "dev" instead of the actual version (`3.2.1`).

To fix this, the version should be read directly from `package.json` at runtime or embedded during build time, ensuring the correct version is reported in production environments.
